text:
alex: Heads up — visibility on the 16th St bridge is basically soup. BART said trains might skip a few stops. Anyone delayed?

tara: Stuck on a slow 22 bus. Driver is like were cruising at ghost speed. Can confirm visibility = soup. :bowl_with_spoon: :fog:

li: My bike commute was fine until the fog ate my sunglasses. Had to ride squinting like a mole. Not recommended.

miguel: @alex I was on the Powell train and they announced skip stop mode. Ended up getting off at Civic Center and walking. Reminder: check BART app before you leave.

ops-bot: Alert: BART system message — "Due to low visibility, select trains may operate limited stops. Expect 10-20 min delays." https://status.bart.example/alerts

alex: Quick poll: if you're rerouting, are you taking (1) bus, (2) bike, (3) walk, (4) rideshare? React with :one: :two: :three: :four:

tara: :one: Bus for me. Warm, dry, questionable ambience.

li: :two: Bike but slow. Also wearing two pairs of socks because why not.

miguel: :three: Walked for a bit. Also bought a coffee at the corner and accidentally handed the barista 5 cents. We're all on brand today.

alex: lol @miguel classic. If anyone needs a dry pair of shoes, I parked an extra pair under my desk (return policy: one high five).

commute-bot: SF Muni: "28 38 experiencing delays due to low visibility." ETA updates in transit app.

li: Also PSA: if you see me squinting, it's not a mood, it's a fog casualty. Please offer a coffee. :coffee:

tara: Meeting reschedule? If more than 15 min late, let's push the 9am stand to 9:30. @product please advise.

miguel: 9:30 works for me. Saves me from presenting while I smell like wet socks.

alex: 9:30 it is. Thanks everyone. Stay visible (literally). :wave:
